items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: And we'd go in places with Boynells when people didn't want to play their own piano.

ctx.x: Harold played piano. Their older sister played piano. I think that's how they come one by another like that. Then uh, Everetta played piano. Chani played piano. Lester played piano. And Bernard played piano. But I don't think he had no lessons. I think this from one to another. See this like uh, uh, when I was small, the girl at the corner of my house was to play piano. I used to get lined up a few pieces from her when I'd go home and my brother would catch him like that. Yeah. And I was like, uh, uh, uh, uh, uh,…
He wasn't just the blues piano then. Blues piano.
